ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_TREASURYTRADEFINANCIALPRODUCT_TRY] AS

-- Diamond Savings Account -- 
SELECT
	BTT.Trade_Id AS TradeId

	,BTT.Name AS Name
	,BTT.PRODUCT_CODE_ISIN AS ProductCodeIsIn
	,BTT.Trade_Currency AS TradeCurrency
	,BTT.PRODUCT_CODE_CBC_BondType AS ProductCodeCbcBondType
	,BTT.TRADE_KEYWORD_1_MM_TradeType AS TradeKeyword1MmTradeType
	,BTT.External_Reference AS ExternalReference
	,BTT.Bundle_Type AS BundleType
	,BTT.TRADE_KEYWORD_OrigTrade AS TradeKeyWordOrigTrade
	,NULL AS BundleId
	,BTT.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,'TRY' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,BTT.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM BUSC.TRY_Trades BTT
WHERE BTT.Product_Type = 'StructuredFlows'
AND BTT.TRADE_KEYWORD_1_MM_TradeType = 'DSA'
AND BTT.ISLATEST = 1

	,BTT.PRODUCT_CODE_CBC_BondType AS ProductCodeCbcBondType

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_TreasuryTradeFinancialProduct FROM TEMP_BNKM_TreasuryTradeFinancialProduct;


-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_TreasuryTradeFinancialProduct_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(int,TradeId)
,convert(varchar,FinancialProductId)
,convert(varchar,ProductType)
,convert(varchar,Name)
,convert(varchar,ProductCodeIsIn)
,convert(varchar,TradeCurrency)
,convert(varchar,ProductCodeCbcBondType)
,convert(varchar,TradeKeyword1MmTradeType)
,convert(varchar,ExternalReference)
,convert(varchar,BundleType)
,convert(varchar,TradeKeyWordOrigTrade)
,convert(int,BundleId)
)) HASHROW, TradeId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_TreasuryTradeFinancialProduct 
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_TreasuryTradeFinancialProduct_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(int,TradeId)
,convert(varchar,FinancialProductId)
,convert(varchar,ProductType)
,convert(varchar,Name)
,convert(varchar,ProductCodeIsIn)
,convert(varchar,TradeCurrency)
,convert(varchar,ProductCodeCbcBondType)
,convert(varchar,TradeKeyword1MmTradeType)
,convert(varchar,ExternalReference)
,convert(varchar,BundleType)
,convert(varchar,TradeKeyWordOrigTrade)
,convert(int,BundleId)
)) HASHROW, TradeId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.TreasuryTradeFinancialProduct --WHERE SOURCE_CODE = 'TRY'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_TreasuryTradeFinancialProduct_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.TradeId,TGT.TradeId) AS TradeId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
	,CASE
		WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_TreasuryTradeFinancialProduct_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_TreasuryTradeFinancialProduct_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.TradeId = TGT.TradeId
AND	SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND	SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW  OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_TreasuryTradeFinancialProduct_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_TreasuryTradeFinancialProduct_DELTA;


---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
	TradeId = SRC.TradeId
	,FinancialProductId = SRC.FinancialProductId
	,ProductType = SRC.ProductType
	,Name = SRC.Name
	,ProductCodeIsIn = SRC.ProductCodeIsIn
	,TradeCurrency = SRC.TradeCurrency
	,ProductCodeCbcBondType = SRC.ProductCodeCbcBondType
	,TradeKeyword1MmTradeType = SRC.TradeKeyword1MmTradeType
	,ExternalReference = SRC.ExternalReference
	,BundleType = SRC.BundleType
	,TradeKeyWordOrigTrade = SRC.TradeKeyWordOrigTrade
	,BundleId = SRC.BundleId
	,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,SourceSystemCode = 'TRY'
	,WorkFlowId = 0
	,TaskRunId = 0
	,InsertDttm = SRC.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.TreasuryTradeFinancialProduct TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_TreasuryTradeFinancialProduct_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.TradeId = TGT.TradeId  
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId  
AND DELTA.TradeId = TGT.TradeId  
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_TreasuryTradeFinancialProduct SRC 
ON SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode ;

 
-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.TreasuryTradeFinancialProduct
(
	TradeId
	,FinancialProductId
	,ProductType
	,Name
	,ProductCodeIsIn
	,TradeCurrency
	,ProductCodeCbcBondType
	,TradeKeyword1MmTradeType
	,ExternalReference
	,BundleType
	,TradeKeyWordOrigTrade
	,BundleId
    ,FinancialInstitutionId
	,SourceSystemCode
	,WorkFlowId 
	,TaskRunId 
	,InsertDttm
)
SELECT 
	SRC.TradeId
	,SRC.FinancialProductId
	,SRC.ProductType
	,SRC.Name
	,SRC.ProductCodeIsIn
	,SRC.TradeCurrency
	,SRC.ProductCodeCbcBondType
	,SRC.TradeKeyword1MmTradeType
	,SRC.ExternalReference
	,SRC.BundleType
	,SRC.TradeKeyWordOrigTrade
	,SRC.BundleId
    ,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,'TRY' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId 
	,0 AS TaskRunId 
	,SRC.InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_TreasuryTradeFinancialProduct SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_TreasuryTradeFinancialProduct_DELTA DELTA
 ON DELTA.TradeId = SRC.TradeId 
 AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId 
 AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode 
WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_TreasuryTradeFinancialProduct;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_TreasuryTradeFinancialProduct_DELTA;
